Wellness suitability is best at 1000 per cm³ or above. Urban indoor levels are often below 100 per cm³, while humid forest areas and waterfall surroundings reach the highest concentrations, so you can use this to site wellness bases and assess scenic area environments.

map.负离子越高越好吗？: Is a higher concentration always better?
High concentrations are usually associated with clean, low-negative-ion environments, but a single index cannot represent overall air quality, so combine it with PM2.5, ozone, temperature and humidity for a full assessment.
